hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: The sum of absolute differences sum(|nums[i] - y|) is minimized when y is the median of nums.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Since y must be a palindrome, the optimal palindrome will be either the greatest palindrome <= median or the smallest palindrome >= median.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Sort nums, find median nums[n // 2], generate candidate palindromes near the median, and compute minimum total cost.

variables: n: size of input array or string
